ORDER The petitioners are sought to prosecute for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 376, 313,
341, 354, 509, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Section 3(1)(xi) of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 alleging that the petitioner/accused No.1 by promising to marry CW-1 had sexual intercourse with CW-1 and when she was pregnant, she was forced to terminate the pregnancy at the instance of the Petitioners herein.

entities.text: Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Accused No.1 had approached this Court in Crl.P.No.3596/2018 challenging the impugned proceedings, and this Court vide order 22.06.2022 quashed the proceedings against accused No.1 by observing as follows:-
NC: 2023:KHC:40541 "4.
A FIR was lodged by the 2nd respondent alleging that two years prior to the lodging of FIR, the petitioner -accused No.1 and CW1 were in love Sri.

Ramachandra M.C vs State Of Karnataka on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119479152/
2 with each other and the accused No.1 forcibly had sexual intercourse with CW1 and when she was pregnant, the petitioner - accused No.1 forced her to terminate the pregnancy.

entities.text: Ramachandra M.C vs State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was further alleged that after having sexual intercourse with CW1 on three to four occasions, the petitioner - accused No.1 started to avoid her and on 22.7.2017 she attempted to commit suicide.
Since the petitioner - accused No.1 came to the hospital and promised to marry CW1, CW1 did not lodge FIR against the petitioner - accused No.1.
Thereafter, his friends i.e. other accused threatened her and outraged her modesty.
The police after investigation submitted a charge sheet for the aforesaid offences.

5. The Apex Court in the case of Sonu @ Subhash Kumar -vs- State of Uttar Pradesh and another reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 181 by referring to the decision in the case of Pramod Suryabhan Pawar -vs- State of Maharashtra reported in (2019) 9 SCC 608 at para-11 has held that in the absence of 4 allegation that promise to marry was false promise at the inception, the false promise itself must be of immediate relevance or bear a direct nexus to the woman's decision to engage in the sexual act.

entities.text: Sonu @ Subhash Kumar -vs- State of Uttar Pradesh and another reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 181
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Pramod Suryabhan Pawar -vs- State of Maharashtra reported in (2019) 9 SCC 608
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the present case, there is no allegation that promise made to the 2nd respondent was false at the inception.

Charge sheet material does not disclose that the petitioner by using force or by assaulting has outraged the modesty of the victim so as to constitute the offence punishable under Section 3(1)(xi) of Atrocities Act.

Hence, in the absence of any essential ingredients so as to constitute the offences alleged against the petitioner- accused No.1, the filing of charge sheet against the petitioner - accused no.1 is without any substance."

Following the order passed by this Court, accused Nos.2 and 4 against whom similar allegations were made have been discharged by the learned Special Judge by order dated 23.09.2023 in S.C.No.985/2019, this petition also requires to be disposed of in terms of the aforesaid order so as to maintain parity.

pending on the file of LXX Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge and Special Judge, Benglauru (CCH-71), insofar as it relates to accused Nos.3 and 5 is hereby quashed and accused Nos.2 and 4 are discharged of the offences alleged against them.
